name: qr-for-agent

tools.name: create_qr_code
tools.description: Create a new managed QR code with optional custom styling. The QR code points to a short URL that redirects to your target URL. You can change the target URL later without regenerating the QR image. Supports custom colors, dot shapes, corner shapes, and logo embedding.

target_url.description: The destination URL the QR code should redirect to.

label.description: An optional label to identify this QR code.

format.description: Image format. "svg" is recommended (smaller, scalable, text-parseable). Use "png" only if a bitmap is required.

foreground_color.description: Hex color for QR code dots. Default: #000000 (black).

background_color.description: Hex color for QR code background. Default: #ffffff (white).

width.description: QR code width in pixels. Default: 400.

margin.description: Quiet zone margin in modules. Default: 2.

error_correction.description: Error correction level. L=7%, M=15% (default), Q=25%, H=30%. Auto-set to H when logo is provided.

dot_style.description: Shape of data modules. square=classic, rounded=soft corners, dots=circles, classy-rounded=organic.

corner_style.description: Shape of finder patterns (corner squares). square=classic, extra-rounded=smooth, dot=circular.

logo_url.description: URL to a logo image (PNG/JPG/SVG) or data:base64 URI. Centered on the QR code.

logo_size.description: Logo size as ratio of QR width (0.15-0.3). Default: 0.2.

gradient.description: Apply a gradient to QR dots and corners instead of solid foreground_color.

frame_style.description: Decorative frame around QR. 'banner_bottom': text below, 'banner_top': text above, 'rounded': rounded border with text.

frame_text.description: CTA text on the frame (e.g. 'Scan Me!', 'View Menu'). Max 30 chars. Requires frame_style.

frame_color.description: Hex color for frame background. Default: #000000.

frame_text_color.description: Hex color for frame text. Default: #ffffff.

frame_border_radius.description: Frame corner radius. Only for 'rounded' style.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time. After this date, scanning returns 410 Gone instead of redirecting.

scheduled_url.description: Replacement URL that activates at scheduled_at.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time when target automatically switches to scheduled_url.

gtm_container_id.description: Google Tag Manager container ID (e.g. 'GTM-ABC123'). Enables GTM tracking on QR scans via an intermediate HTML page.

tools.name: get_qr_code
tools.description: Retrieve details of an existing QR code by its short ID. Returns the current target URL, metadata, and timestamps.

short_id.description: The short ID of the QR code to look up.

tools.name: update_qr_destination
tools.description: Change where an existing QR code redirects to. This is the key 'dynamic link' feature: the QR image stays the same, but scanning it will now go to the new URL. Ideal for updating campaigns, fixing broken links, or A/B testing.

short_id.description: The short ID of the QR code to update.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiration date. Set to null to remove expiration.

scheduled_url.description: Scheduled replacement URL. Set to null to cancel.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 activation date for scheduled_url. Set to null to cancel.

gtm_container_id.description: Google Tag Manager container ID. Set to null to remove GTM tracking.

tools.name: list_qr_codes
tools.description: List all managed QR codes with pagination. Returns short IDs, target URLs, labels, and timestamps. Use this to browse or search for existing QR codes.

tools.name: delete_qr_code
tools.description: Permanently delete a QR code and all its scan analytics. The short URL will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.

short_id.description: The short ID of the QR code to delete.

tools.name: get_qr_analytics
tools.description: Get enriched scan analytics for a QR code. Returns total scans, daily trends, device/browser/country/referer breakdowns with percentages, and recent scan events with parsed user-agent and geo data.

short_id.description: The short ID of the QR code to get analytics for.

tools.name: bulk_create_qr_codes
tools.description: Create multiple QR codes in a single request (up to 50). Each item supports the same options as create_qr_code. The quota check is all-or-nothing: if the batch would exceed your plan limit, no QR codes are created. Ideal for generating QR codes for product catalogs, event lists, or batch operations.

items.description: Array of QR codes to create. Max 50 per request.

tools.name: bulk_update_qr_codes
tools.description: Update multiple QR codes in a single request (up to 50). Change target URLs and/or labels. Items with non-existent short_id are reported as not_found without failing the whole batch.

short_id.description: The short_id of the QR code to update.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiration date. Null to clear.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 activation date. Null to cancel.

items.description: Array of QR code updates. Max 50 per request.

tools.name: bulk_delete_qr_codes
tools.description: Delete multiple QR codes and their scan analytics in a single request (up to 50). Items with non-existent short_id are reported as not_found without failing the whole batch.

short_ids.description: Array of short_id strings to delete. Max 50 per request.

tools.name: create_vcard_qr
tools.description: Create a QR code that encodes a contact card (vCard). When scanned by a phone camera, it prompts the user to save the contact. Supports all standard vCard fields and custom QR styling.

tools.name: create_wifi_qr
tools.description: Create a QR code that encodes WiFi credentials. When scanned by a phone camera, it offers to auto-join the WiFi network. No internet connection needed to join — the credentials are encoded directly in the QR image.

password.description: WiFi password. Omit for open networks (use encryption='nopass').

hidden.description: Whether the network is hidden. Default: false.

tools.name: update_vcard_qr
tools.description: Update the contact details of a vCard QR code. Only works on QR codes created with type='vcard'. Partial updates merge with existing data. Note: updating vCard data changes the QR image content.

short_id.description: The short ID of the vCard QR code to update.

tools.name: update_wifi_qr
tools.description: Update the WiFi credentials of a WiFi QR code. Only works on QR codes created with type='wifi'. Note: updating WiFi data changes the QR image content.

short_id.description: The short ID of the WiFi QR code to update.

tools.name: create_email_qr
tools.description: Create a QR code that opens a pre-filled email when scanned. The recipient, subject, body, CC, and BCC can all be pre-set.

tools.name: create_sms_qr
tools.description: Create a QR code that opens a pre-filled SMS message when scanned. Set the phone number and optional message text.

phone_number.description: Phone number to send SMS to.

tools.name: create_phone_qr
tools.description: Create a QR code that initiates a phone call when scanned. The phone number is encoded directly in the QR code.

tools.name: create_event_qr
tools.description: Create a QR code that adds a calendar event when scanned. Encodes a standard iCalendar VEVENT that calendar apps can import.

start.description: Event start date-time in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2026-03-15T09:00:00Z).

end.description: Event end date-time in ISO 8601 format.

tools.name: create_text_qr
tools.description: Create a QR code that contains plain text. When scanned, the text is displayed directly. Useful for messages, notes, or any freeform content.

tools.name: create_location_qr
tools.description: Create a QR code that opens a map location when scanned. Encodes geographic coordinates that map apps can parse.

tools.name: create_social_qr
tools.description: Create a QR code that links to social media profiles. When scanned via the short URL, returns a JSON object with all platform links. Provide at least one platform link.

tools.name: create_app_store_qr
tools.description: Create a QR code that redirects to the correct app store based on the device. iPhones go to the App Store, Android devices go to Google Play, and other devices go to the fallback URL. Provide at least one store URL.

tools.name: update_social_qr
tools.description: Update the social media links of a Social QR code. Partial updates merge with existing data.

short_id.description: The short ID of the Social QR code to update.

tools.name: update_app_store_qr
tools.description: Update the app store URLs of an App Store QR code. Partial updates merge with existing data.

short_id.description: The short ID of the App Store QR code to update.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Register a webhook endpoint to receive real-time notifications when QR codes are scanned. Returns an HMAC-SHA256 secret for verifying webhook signatures — store it securely, it is only shown once.

url.description: The endpoint URL that will receive POST requests with scan event data.

events.description: Events to subscribe to. Currently supported: "qr.scanned".

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List all registered webhook endpoints for your API key. The HMAC secret is not included for security.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook endpoint and all its delivery logs. The endpoint will stop receiving events immediately.

webhook_id.description: The ID of the webhook to delete. Use list_webhooks to find IDs.

tools.name: register
tools.description: Register for an API key. Provide your email to get a key immediately.

label.description: An optional label to identify this API key.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Get current usage and quota for your API key.

tools.name: upgrade_to_pro
tools.description: Upgrade to the Pro plan ($19/month) for unlimited QR codes, scans, and webhooks. Returns a Stripe Checkout URL — tell the user to open it in their browser to complete payment. The upgrade takes effect automatically after payment.

tools.name: manage_billing
tools.description: Open the Stripe billing portal to manage your subscription, update payment method, or cancel. Returns a portal URL — tell the user to open it in their browser. Only works if you have an active Pro subscription.

tools.name: set_utm_params
tools.description: Set UTM tracking parameters on a URL QR code. These parameters are automatically appended to the target URL on every scan redirect. Use this to track QR code scans in Google Analytics or other analytics tools. Set 'clear' to true to remove all UTM parameters.

short_id.description: The short ID of the QR code (must be type='url').

clear.description: Set to true to remove all UTM parameters from this QR code.

tools.name: set_redirect_rules
tools.description: Set conditional redirect rules on a URL QR code. Rules are evaluated top-to-bottom; each rule has an array of conditions (AND logic) — all must match. First matching rule's URL is used. If no rule matches, the default target_url applies. Conditions: 'device' (mobile/tablet/desktop), 'os' (iOS/Android/Windows/macOS/Linux), 'country' (ISO alpha-2 like 'FR'), 'language' (ISO 639-1 like 'fr'), 'time_range' ({start:'09:00',end:'17:00',timezone:'Europe/Paris'}), 'ab_split' ({percentage:50}). Combine conditions in a single rule for AND logic (e.g. mobile + FR). Pass an empty array to remove all rules.

short_id.description: The short ID of the QR code (must be type='url').

value.description: Condition value. String for device/os/country/language. Object for time_range and ab_split.

conditions.description: Array of conditions (AND logic). All must match for this rule to trigger.

target_url.description: URL to redirect to when all conditions match.

rules.description: Array of redirect rules. Empty array to clear all rules.

tools.name: set_custom_domain
tools.description: Set a custom domain for your QR code short URLs (Pro plan required). When set, all new QR codes will use https://your-domain.com/r/... instead of the default URL. You must configure DNS (CNAME) to point to the QR Agent server. Pass domain=null to remove the custom domain.

domain.description: Your custom domain without protocol (e.g. 'qr.mybrand.com'). Pass null to remove.

tools.name: get_custom_domain
tools.description: Get your current custom domain configuration and DNS verification status. Returns the domain, whether DNS is active or pending, and setup instructions.

tools.name: bulk_create_from_csv
tools.description: Create up to 500 QR codes from CSV data. Pro plan required. Send the CSV content as a string. Required column: target_url. Optional columns: label, format, type, foreground_color, background_color, dot_style, corner_style, frame_style, frame_text, expires_at. Returns all created QR codes.

csv_content.description: CSV content as a string with header row. Example: "target_url,label\nhttps://example.com,My QR\nhttps://other.com,Other QR"

tools.name: record_conversion
tools.description: Record a post-scan conversion event (purchase, signup, etc.) for a QR code you own. Use this to track ROI — e.g., when a user scans a QR code and then makes a purchase, record a 'purchase' conversion with the order value. For client-side tracking without code, use the tracking pixel: .

short_id.description: The short_id of the QR code this conversion is for.

event.description: The conversion event name (e.g., "purchase", "signup", "add_to_cart"). Use consistent names to aggregate stats.

value.description: Optional monetary value of the conversion (e.g., 49.99).

metadata.description: Optional JSON metadata (e.g., product ID, order number).

tools.name: get_conversions
tools.description: Get conversion statistics for a QR code. Returns total conversions, total value, breakdowns by event name, daily trends, and recent events. Use this to measure QR code ROI and understand which codes drive the most value.

short_id.description: The short_id of the QR code to get conversion stats for.
